# Version 4.159.0 (Unreleased)
> **Image comparisons and rendering fixes**

## Highlights

The next release adds experimental image comparisons and fixes runtime-effect uniforms, texture sampling, and Windows image-decoding crashes. SkiaSharp.Testing provides configurable image comparisons and visual difference diagnostics. Linux x86 native assets are no longer packaged; applications targeting that architecture must move to a supported architecture.

## Breaking Changes

- **Move Linux x86 applications to a supported architecture** — Linux x86 native assets are no longer built or included in NuGet packages. Retarget applications that depend on those assets to a supported architecture before upgrading. ([#5784](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5784))

## API Surface

- **Experimental image-comparison package** — SkiaSharp.Testing compares SKImage, SKBitmap, and SKPixmap inputs with channel tolerances, masks, mismatch budgets, and error metrics, and creates visual difference images. The assembly is experimental: consumers opt in by suppressing SKIA4001. Returned difference images are caller-owned and must be disposed. ([#5293](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5293))

## Bug Fixes

- **Windows x64 decoder crash recovery** — Fixes process crashes during libjpeg/libpng error recovery in Windows x64 clang builds, including PDF output with lazy non-JPEG images and malformed JPEG input to SKCodec.Create. Windows arm64, x86, and MSVC builds are unchanged. — ❤️ [@SimonCropp](https://github.com/SimonCropp) ([#5827](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5827))
- **Zeroed runtime-effect uniforms** — New SKRuntimeEffectUniforms buffers now start at zero instead of containing uninitialized data. Reset() clears the existing buffer in place, restoring documented zero values without allocating a replacement native buffer and wrapper. — ❤️ [@taublast](https://github.com/taublast) ([#5843](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5843))
- **Safer Ganesh texture-subset filtering** — Linear filtering clamps samples slightly inside texture-subset edges to avoid including undefined exterior texels. Ganesh texture-edge pixels may change; CPU and Graphite rendering are unaffected. ([#5679](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5679))
- **Tizen CPU blur selection** — Tizen now applies its intended CPU blur configuration to Skia itself, selecting the existing ThreeBoxApprox/Tent paths instead of the shader-based Gaussian candidate. Blur pixels and performance may differ; Tizen rendering and performance were not measured in the source change. ([#5679](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5679))
